report_name: N-able N-central RMM Hit by 'Able2Shell' Zero-Day Vulnerabilities

tools.name: N-central
tools.description: A remote monitoring and management (RMM) platform by N-able that was found to have over 30 zero-day vulnerabilities, collectively dubbed 'Able2Shell'.

tools.name: java
tools.description: The N-central server's primary process, which could be monitored for suspicious child process creation as an indicator of compromise.

tools.name: bash

vulnerabilities.name: CVE-2026-125883
vulnerabilities.description: An unauthenticated XML External Entity (XXE) injection vulnerability in N-able N-central that allows an attacker to read arbitrary files and conduct server-side request forgery (SSRF). Part of the 'Able2Shell' disclosure.

vulnerabilities.name: CVE-2026-125878
vulnerabilities.description: An Object-Graph Navigation Language (OGNL) injection vulnerability in N-able N-central that can be leveraged for unauthenticated remote code execution. Part of the 'Able2Shell' disclosure.

identities.name: N-able
identities.description: IT software provider and vendor of the N-central RMM platform. The company took its hosted services offline and released an emergency patch after the 'Able2Shell' zero-day disclosure.

identities.name: Managed Service Providers (MSPs)

indicators.name: N-able N-central Suspicious Child Process
indicators.pattern:
title: N-able N-central Suspicious Child Process
id: 2f8b1c9a-7e6d-4f5a-8b3c-1d9e8f7a6b5c
status: experimental
description: Detects suspicious child processes such as shells or network utilities being spawned by the N-able N-central Java process, which may indicate exploitation of Able2Shell RCE vulnerabilities like CVE-2026-125878.
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-11-11
references:
  - https://thehackernews.com/2026/11/n-able-takes-hosted-n-central-offline.html
tags:
  - attack.t1059
  - attack.execution
level: critical
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_parent:
    ParentImage|contains: 'java'
    ParentCommandLine|contains: 'com.nable.server.main.Main'
  selection_child:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\bash.exe'
      - '\sh.exe'
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\curl.exe'
      - '\wget.exe'
  condition: all of selection_*
falsepositives:
  - Unlikely, but custom administrative scripts could trigger this rule.
indicators.description: Detects the N-central Java process spawning unusual child processes like shells or network utilities, a strong indicator of remote code execution from vulnerabilities like CVE-2026-125878.

indicators.name: N-able N-central XXE Injection Attempt
indicators.pattern:
title: N-able N-central XXE Injection Attempt
id: 8a7b6c5d-4e3f-4a2b-9c8d-1e9f8a7b6c5d
status: experimental
description: Detects web requests to the N-able N-central login endpoint containing patterns indicative of XML External Entity (XXE) injection attempts, related to CVE-2026-125883.
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-11-11
references:
  - https://thehackernews.com/2026/11/n-able-takes-hosted-n-central-offline.html
tags:
  - attack.t1190
  - attack.initial_access
level: high
logsource:
  category: proxy
detection:
  selection:
    cs-method: 'POST'
    c-uri|contains: '/dms/Login'
    body|contains|all:
      - '<?xml'
      - '<!ENTITY'
      - 'SYSTEM'
  condition: selection
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate but unusual XML payloads.
indicators.description: Detects unusual POST requests to N-central login endpoints containing XML payloads, which could indicate attempts to exploit the XXE vulnerability (CVE-2026-125883).
